tools.name: build_receipt_spreadsheet
tools.description: Turn receipts you have read into an Excel (.xlsx), CSV, Xero or QuickBooks import file, with VAT split into one column per rate. Returns totals per currency and VAT rate, warnings where net + VAT doesn't match the total, and a download link valid for 24 hours. Up to 200 receipts per call.

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: The European Central Bank reference rate for a currency on a date (the last published rate on or before it), and the converted amount.

tools.name: scan_receipts_on_website
tools.description: Link to InvoiceSnap's own scanner, for when receipt photos are hard to read or there are many: it reads photos and PDFs (up to 50 at once) and exports the same files.
